host.note: Files sit in tmpfs (RAM): this run measures CPU, memory and the algorithm, not the SSD.
host.scratch_fs: tmpfs, 7.5 GiB free of the mount at start

notes: on-disk pair: ext2/ext3 on /dev/sda2, Samsung SSD 860 (ssd). The script cannot drop the page cache without root, so the cache state is whatever the host had: the pair was written just before the first read, so the last pages of B may be cached. A and B together are 100.0 GiB against 15.0 GiB of RAM; that exceeds RAM, so most reads come from the disk. Reads run at idle I/O priority (ionice -c3), which can lengthen them on a busy disk. diff and git diff were not run: GNU diff holds far more than the 1 GiB rift cap for files this size.
